situations.headline: BJ's Restaurants adds two independent directors (Brandt, White) in board refresh

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: BJ's Restaurants adds two independent directors (Brandt, White) in board refresh (interest 4, risk 2)

thesis.text: BJ's Restaurants is executing a governance refresh, adding experienced restaurant/CPG operators to its board alongside undisclosed bylaw and other-event items in the same 8-K; the full scope of the filing (fiscal year/bylaw amendments, other events) is not yet visible, warranting monitoring of subsequent filings for concrete operational or capital-structure implications before forming a variant view.
